description: This header file defines macros for performance optimization, including tail call optimization, cache line size and alignment, branch prediction hints, unreachable code, and compiler assumptions, primarily used for performance tuning in C++ projects.

methods.name: ABSL_BLOCK_TAIL_CALL_OPTIMIZATION
methods.description: Macro to prevent tail call optimization, varies by compiler.

methods.name: ABSL_CACHELINE_SIZE
methods.description: Macro defining the size of cache line for alignment purposes.

methods.name: ABSL_CACHELINE_ALIGNED
methods.description: Macro to align objects to cache line size.

methods.name: ABSL_PREDICT_TRUE
methods.description: Macro hinting the compiler that a condition is likely true.

methods.name: ABSL_PREDICT_FALSE
methods.description: Macro hinting the compiler that a condition is likely false.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_IMMEDIATE_ABORT_IMPL
methods.description: Macro to abort program immediately, platform-specific.

methods.name: ABSL_UNREACHABLE
methods.description: Macro indicating unreachable code, with behavior depending on build mode.

methods.name: ABSL_ASSUME
methods.description: Macro to inform compiler of an assumed condition for optimization.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_UNIQUE_SMALL_NAME
methods.description: Macro to generate small, unique symbol names for static variables/functions.
